help.title: Help
help.payLateAnswer: Write down the date and the amount you were told. Keep any message from the employer. Ask the employer politely first. If you are still not paid, call our support.
help.safeAnswer: Before you travel, ask for the exact address, hours and pay. Tell someone you trust where you are going. Never pay money to get a job. If anything feels wrong, call our support.
help.changeNumberAnswer: Open the Me tab, choose Edit my details, and change the mobile number.
help.askJob: I have a question about a job
help.askJobAnswer: Tap the voice button in the bottom bar and call Phala. Phala can explain a job, the pay and the next step.

call.heading: Phala will *call you*
call.body: Phala calls this number and asks a few short questions. Just answer on the phone. It takes about 2 minutes.
